title_idea: The Quran Stamps Exactly Two Wealth Laws 'An Obligation From God' — Inheritance and Zakat
claim: The exact 3-word phrase 'fareedatan min Allah' (فريضة من الله — 'an obligation/ordained share from Allah') appears in exactly 2 verses of the Quran, in mushaf order 4:11 and 9:60. 4:11 is the verse fixing the mandatory inheritance shares (children get such-and-such, parents the sixth, etc.); 9:60 is the verse fixing the eight categories of zakat recipients (the poor, the needy, the collectors, etc.). Both verses END on this identical stamp AND then close with the same divine seal of knowledge and wisdom: 4:11 '...fareedatan min Allah, inna Allaha kana aliman hakiman'; 9:60 '...fareedatan min Allah, wa Allahu alimun hakim'. Scope: exact contiguous phrase in the undiacritized simple text (textSimple), tokenized on whitespace; 2 verses.
evidence: find('فريضة من الله') = 2 verses: 4:11 (inheritance shares) and 9:60 (zakat recipients). 4:11 tail: '...لا تدرون ايهم اقرب لكم نفعا فريضة من الله ان الله كان عليما حكيما'. 9:60 tail: '...وفي سبيل الله وابن السبيل فريضة من الله والله عليم حكيم'. Note the near-miss 'من الله والله عليم' also links 4:12 and 9:60; the whole inheritance/zakat block is stitched by this seal. 'fareedatan' as a bare word also occurs at 4:24 (dower) and 2:236/2:237 (settlement), but never followed by 'min Allah' outside 4:11 and 9:60.

Confirm both verses also end with the alim/hakim seal by printing full textSimple.
overlap_note: none — no published article touches 'fareedatan min Allah' or pairs inheritance with zakat. Nearest published are the rizq/economic-theology pieces (rizq-gratitude-economic-theology-quran), which are about provision and gratitude, not the two divinely-fixed wealth transfers.
angle: There are only two moments in the whole Quran where God signs a wealth distribution with the words 'an obligation from Me' — the shares the dead leave behind, and the shares the living owe the poor. Both times He adds the same signature: 'and Allah is Knowing, Wise.' The two times money leaves your hands by God's math instead of yours get the identical divine stamp.
